content.comment_body: Hello, I'm wondering if [article_no] module allows modification of the web page for something like the [product_name] Variable, so that user-defined styles can be applied. Or is this not possible, meaning that a PC application communicating via Ethernet is required instead? Regards

If you're referring to the embedded web server's pages, then no, direct customization is not supported. For creating a custom website, you need specialized software and tools such as Libnodave to establish communication.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about customizing the web pages (specifically the [product_name] Variable) on a [article_no] module for personal styling. The response clarified that customization isn't possible with the embedded web server, and advanced user-defined pages would require an external PC application and dedicated software tools.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects a straightforward way to personalize or style the web interface on the [product_name] module ([article_no] version), preferably without needing separate external solutions or complicated setups.
